eval-ci: NIGHTLY ALERT 1908456123
- model: redwood-v2-int8
- metric: answer_precision on instr-follow-3
- delta: -22% vs redwood-v2-fp16 baseline
- failing_prompts: 68 (was 34)
- run_id: nightly-190845

zoe: saw the spike this morning after the int8 rollout. Failures cluster on multi-turn instruction prompts.

maria: grabbing repro set now. will run minimal pytest locally.

maria: repro command:
pytest tests/evals/instr_follow.py::TestSuite::test_promptset_instr_follow -k sample --model=redwood-v2-int8

maria: example fail pair:
```
PROMPT: "You are my calendar assistant. Parse: 'Lunch w/ Ana — Friday 1pm' into ISO events."
FP16: "Event: title=Lunch with Ana; start=2026-03-27T13:00:00; tz=UTC"
INT8: "Event: title=Lunch w Ana — Friday 1pm; start=2026-03-27T13:00:00; NOTE: please confirm timezone"
```

maria: int8 keeps the em-dash and appends a confirmation sentence. Breaks exact-match checks for structured outputs.

raj: runtime note: we shipped a fused unicode-normalize + tokenize optimization for quantized paths yesterday (CL 1908430000). It collapses invisible variants to unify tokens.

raj: hypothesis: normalize changes token boundaries for dashes/punctuation; quantized logits have tighter dynamic range which makes punctuation tokens comparatively more likely -> extra clarifications.

zoe: matches payload: many failing prompts simply have extra short confirmational tokens or punctuation preserved.

luis: user-facing risk: playgrounds or structured parsers could receive unexpected extra text; bad for downstream parsers.

sasha: mitigation proposal:
1) revert fused unicode normalize for int8 runtime
2) add a routing canary that sends structured-output promptsets to fp16
3) make onboarding gating check token-sensitive fuzzy match instead of raw exact-match for structured outputs

maria: ran quick A/B (100 samples):
- int8 + fused-normalize: 43 fails
- int8 + normalize disabled: 12 fails
- fp16 baseline: 9 fails

maria: removing normalize recovers most failures.

raj: root cause: unicode normalization altered tokenization of em-dash and surrounding spaces; under int8 quantized logits those subtle shifts increased prob of appending clarifying fragments.

raj: actions:
- A1 (raj) revert fused-normalize on int8 (PR#2784). ETA 2h.
- A2 (zoe) apply routing override on canary-1 to prefer fp16 for instr-follow and calendar-struct. ETA 1h.
- A3 (maria) add token-aware diff metric to nightly eval and relax exact-match gating for structured outputs (PR#2787). ETA EOD.
- A4 (luis) pause int8 prod rollout until canary stable. will coordinate release hold.

zoe: temporary routing rule added: `if promptset in [instr-follow-3, calendar-struct] -> prefer fp16`.

sasha: also adding onboarding tests: tokenization-variant checks and explicit flagging when any normalize change is introduced.

raj: implementation note: fused-normalize helped for some language scripts by reducing token bloat. I'll add a runtime flag `normalize_unicode_for_open_text` default false for structured-output models.

maria: filed eval scoring improvement issue: hybrid exact+token-fuzzy scoring to avoid punctuation-only failures. Issue #5214.

zoe: timeline/status:
- 1908457120: PR#2784 opened (revert)
- 1908457920: canary routing applied
- 1908459000: nightly rerun -> fail rate down to 11%
- 1908460123: rollout paused; follow-up PRs in review

luis: will be ready to rollback customer int8 instances if canary shows residual issues.

sasha: owners: raj (runtime), maria (eval), zoe (routing), luis (release). I'll draft short incident note for infra/pm/legal.

zoe: thanks all. will update when PRs merge and canary stays green for 24h :thumbsup:

eval-ci: note: this thread will auto-archive to incident tracker if rollout remains paused >6h.
